name: USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions
description: Studies how USD/JPY moves in the 1 and 5 days following BOJ rate changes (hikes and cuts). Detects rate decisions from Japan's call money rate (FRED monthly), classifies as hike or cut, then measures forward USDJPY returns. Outputs: grouped bar chart of median returns by decision type and horizon, event markers for each rate change, and a summary statistics table.
source:
# USD/JPY After BOJ Rate Decisions
# Detects BOJ rate hikes/cuts from Japan call money rate changes,
# then measures USDJPY forward 1d and 5d returns after each event.

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# Japan call money rate (monthly, ffilled to daily)
jp_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N')()
jp_rate = ffill(jp_rate_raw.result)

# --- Detect Rate Changes ---
# Compare current rate to prior value; a change = BOJ moved rates
jp_rate_prev = jp_rate >> 1
rate_change = jp_rate - jp_rate_prev

# Classify: hike (rate increased) vs cut (rate decreased)
is_rate_change = is_valid(rate_change) and is_valid(jp_rate_prev) and rate_change != 0
is_hike = is_valid(rate_change) and is_valid(jp_rate_prev) and rate_change > 0
is_cut = is_valid(rate_change) and is_valid(jp_rate_prev) and rate_change < 0

# --- Forward Returns on USDJPY ---
fwd_1d = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)

# Filter by event type
hike_fwd_1d = where(is_hike, fwd_1d)
hike_fwd_5d = where(is_hike, fwd_5d)
cut_fwd_1d = where(is_cut, fwd_1d)
cut_fwd_5d = where(is_cut, fwd_5d)

# --- Output 1: Punchline — Median Returns by Decision Type & Horizon ---
# Grouped bars: stacks = Hike vs Cut, series names = +1d and +5d
xy_bars(mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='How Does USD/JPY React? Median Return by Decision Type',
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Hike'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Cut'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Cut')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(hike_fwd_1d, hike_fwd_5d, cut_fwd_1d, cut_fwd_5d))

# --- Output 2: Event Markers — Each BOJ Rate Change ---
# Rate change magnitude as hero, direction as badge
rate_chg_bps = rate_change * 100
decision_label = conditional_select(is_hike, "Hike", is_cut, "Cut", "Hold")
fwd_1d_at_event = where(is_rate_change, fwd_1d)
fwd_5d_at_event = where(is_rate_change, fwd_5d)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Rate Decision',
        icon=Icon.BanknoteIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Change (bps)', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Decision', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='New Rate (%)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY +1d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDJPY +5d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rate_chg_bps, decision_label, jp_rate, fwd_1d_at_event, fwd_5d_at_event, is_rate_change)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Stats by Horizon ---
# Hike stats
hike_win_1d = 1.0 if (is_hike and fwd_1d > 0) else (0.0 if is_hike else fwd_1d * 0 / 0)
hike_win_5d = 1.0 if (is_hike and fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_hike else fwd_5d * 0 / 0)

# Cut stats
cut_win_1d = 1.0 if (is_cut and fwd_1d > 0) else (0.0 if is_cut else fwd_1d * 0 / 0)
cut_win_5d = 1.0 if (is_cut and fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_cut else fwd_5d * 0 / 0)

summary_table(mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='BOJ Rate Decisions',
    order=2,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BOJ Rate Decision — USDJPY Forward Return Stats',
        row_size=4, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Hike +1d', 'Hike +5d', 'Cut +1d', 'Cut +5d'],
        col_headers=['N (Events)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best / Worst'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(hike_fwd_1d, hike_fwd_1d, hike_win_1d, hike_fwd_1d,
  hike_fwd_5d, hike_fwd_5d, hike_win_5d, hike_fwd_5d,
  cut_fwd_1d, cut_fwd_1d, cut_win_1d, cut_fwd_1d,
  cut_fwd_5d, cut_fwd_5d, cut_win_5d, cut_fwd_5d)
